risks.note: MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' states that scaling a full-service multi-national agency risks delivery misalignment or communication lag between upstream strategy teams and downstream technical execution lines. Management's stated mitigation is a single unified project template governed by the ISO 27001-certified ISMS.
risks.risk: Operational delivery risk across a newly multi-national agency structure

risks.note: Flagged as 'Strategic Portfolio Risks': vulnerability to economic shifts or cost rationalization within a specific industry could disrupt near-term agency billing streams. The stated hedge is vertical focus on Insurance, Healthcare and Financial Services plus a mix shift from time-and-material hours to recurring SaaS.

Managing a global corporate perimeter after the US realignment requires ongoing compliance across distinct legal geographies, cross-border corporate taxation laws, data sovereignty rules and proprietary tool protections; mitigation relies on internal regulatory cells, external corporate advisors and IP ring-fencing protocols.
risks.risk: Cross-border regulatory, taxation, data-sovereignty and IP exposure

risks.note: Listed under MD&A 'Threats': the model requires harmonising creative brand designers and UI-UX consultants in the US with highly technical DXP and AI software engineers at the India GCC. With employee strength of 47 as of March 31, 2026, the delivery base is small relative to the enterprise mandates being pursued.
risks.risk: Talent synchronisation across very different skill pools

risks.note: MD&A 'Threats' notes the full-service digital agency market features intense competition from global consultancies and network agencies, requiring the Company to continuously sharpen its niche in highly regulated verticals such as Insurance and Financial Services.
risks.risk: Intense competition from global consulting firms and legacy network agencies

risks.note: MD&A 'Threats' - general macroeconomic caution can cause clients to split large-scale digital initiatives into smaller, phased rollouts, requiring an agile model able to deliver immediate high-ROI milestones; this pressures deal size and revenue visibility.

The entire onshore sales and marketing engine, and the portfolio of over 250 active clients, sit in Beanstalk Web Solutions LLC, which became a step-down subsidiary only on March 06, 2026. Both the growth thesis and the pro-forma revenue run-rate depend on integrating this entity and on the cross-sell converting; the Secretarial Auditor identified the acquisition of a subsidiary as the one event with a material bearing on the Company's affairs during the audit period.
risks.risk: Dependence on a single, very recently acquired onshore entity for US market access

risks.note: The Secretarial Audit Report records that the Company inadvertently delayed the filing of one form with the Registrar of Companies, and that while systems are commensurate with the size of operations 'the same need to be strengthened further'. Separately, the Board's Report discloses that the Company accepted an unsecured loan from its Directors during the year, indicating promoter funding dependence.
risks.risk: Compliance systems flagged as needing strengthening, and reliance on director funding

sk.overview: Broadcasting and streaming is a segment of the global media & entertainment (M&E) industry undergoing a structural shift to a 'new video economy' - the transition from traditional cable/DTH to internet-delivered video (OTT, FAST, CTV). The shift is characterised by fragmentation of viewership, globalisation of content, and a move to ad-supported models, and it is driving M&E companies to adopt cloud-native, purpose-built streaming-video software for production, preparation, distribution and monetization.
